_provenance: Best mean spellF1 (0.759 all, 0.730 DFL) of the 3-member GRU ensemble (models/tempolens_gru*.pt), features v2, under 5-fold simulated-ATD cross-validation on 10 open matches (python -m tempolens.experiments --model ensemble). Flat for switch 1.5-3; the dead-ball costs barely matter; the change-head bonus did not help.
_tag_prior: 'auto' adds the self-calibrated Smart Tagging prior (tagprior.py). Off until tempolens.diagnostics shows the real tags' reliability on the match; on synthetic tags it gained +0.013 DFL spellF1 when tags were accurate and ~0 when they were random (python -m tempolens.tagstudy).
